title: Schedule of Purchase Agreement and Buyer Terms by In-Place Home Resale Package
content:
**Schedule to the In-Place Home Resale purchase agreement.** The deposit terms and the treatment of the seller's site-lease arrears differ by package:

| Package | Minimum earnest money (percent of the sale price) | Share of a forfeited deposit retained by Hearthstone Home Sales (percent) | Seller's past-due site-lease balance may be paid from the sale proceeds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | not applicable (the parties set their own terms) | not applicable | No |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 5.0 | not applicable | No |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 5.0 | 50.0 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 5.0 | 50.0 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 5.0 | 50.0 | Yes |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 5.0 | 50.0 | Yes |

The schedule sets no forfeited-deposit share where Hearthstone holds no deposit; the rest of a forfeited deposit, after the share shown, goes to the seller.

## Terms common to every package

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Buyer's residency application for the site submitted within | 5 calendar days after the purchase agreement date |
| Financed buyer's loan approval obtained within | 21 calendar days after the purchase agreement date |
| Sale closes within | 30 calendar days after the buyer's residency approval |
| Buyer signs a new site lease rather than assuming the seller's | required |
| Monthly site rent the buyer's new lease starts at | the lot class's standard rent on the closing date, not the seller's rent |

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A purchase agreement dated 10 June: the buyer's residency application is due by 15 June and a financed buyer's loan approval by 1 July. A buyer approved for residency on 20 July: the sale closes by 19 August.
